keeps.name: Cedar Bluff Campground
keeps.waterfront_evidence: Esri+NAIP imagery with rec.gov 232912 per-site coords at 37.3084,-119.5463: nearest RV pads (020, 022) 67-76 m from the OSM Bass Lake shoreline, every site's line to the water crosses Bass Lake Road (FR 222) and a wooded strip/day-use point (rec.gov facility map also draws Road 222 between camp and lake) -> no on-water; rec.gov site notes 'View' on RV sites 001/003/004/005/007, canopy hides the sightline -> lakeview at most.
keeps.inclusion_evidence: recreation.gov 232912 campsite catalog (read 2026-10-26): 22 STANDARD NONELECTRIC double/quad units on paved back-in spurs, all reservable; 20 take a 23-ft motorhome (Max Vehicle Length 30-50 ft; 002 and 013 are 20 ft); Sierra NF page names it as one of the two listings at Lupine/Cedar Bluff.
keeps.note: Sierra National Forest (Bass Lake Ranger District) campground on the south shore of Bass Lake, about 6 miles in on Road 222 from Highway 41 and adjacent to Lupine Campground; concessionaire-run (California Land Management). Three loops of double, triple and quad units in ponderosa pine above Road 222 and the lake; some sites are on slopes, with tent space only on the paved spur. --Claude

facilities.note: The Forest Service page says 'Potable water is not available at this site'; recreation.gov (the concessionaire's listing) says drinking water is provided.

booking.note: recreation.gov rules: maxStay 14 days, minWeekendStay/minHolidayWeekendStay 0 ('soft'), reservationCutOff 1 day prior to arrival. The Forest Service page's 'two night minimum stay on weekends and a three night minimum stay on holidays' and '240 days in advance' are older text (the page still carries a 2009-2011 PG&E dam notice); recreation.gov is current. recreation.gov's calendar shows the campground Closed 2026-10-16 to 2027-05-20. Every unit is a double (two-family) or quad unit; there are no single sites.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:232912: 22 sites, Max Vehicle Length 30-50 (002, 013 = 20 ft), RV equipment max_length 40 on 001/007/019 (001's driveway is listed at 50 ft), Driveway Entry 'Back-in' on all 22

adds.name: Lupine Campground
adds.waterfront_evidence: Esri+NAIP imagery with rec.gov 232802 per-site coords at 37.3074,-119.5443: RV loop on the wooded point, nearest RV pads (081, 082, 085, 087) 51-63 m from the OSM Bass Lake shoreline with Bass Lake Road (FR 222) looping between the sites and the water (visible in the 37.3078,-119.5452 frame) -> no on-water; rec.gov site notes 'View' on RV sites 063/066-069/073 and rec.gov says Lupine is 'set further back from the lake than Cedar Bluff' -> lakeview at most.
adds.inclusion_evidence: recreation.gov 232802 campsite catalog (read 2026-10-26): 39 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites on paved back-in spurs plus 12 hike-in tent sites; 22 take a 23-ft motorhome (sites 063-087, Max Vehicle Length 30-40 ft; 068 and 100-113 are 20 ft, 077 is a 10-ft car spot, 076 not available); Sierra NF page names it as one of the two listings at Lupine/Cedar Bluff.
adds.note: Sierra National Forest (Bass Lake Ranger District) campground on the south shore of Bass Lake, about 6 miles in on Road 222 from Highway 41 and adjacent to Cedar Bluff Campground; concessionaire-run (California Land Management). Sites under big ponderosa pines on the point inside the Road 222 loop; the RV-length sites are 63-87, while 100-113 take 20 ft and 88-99 are hike-in tent sites. --Claude

facilities.note: The Forest Service page says 'Potable water is not available at this site'; recreation.gov (the concessionaire's listing) says drinking water is provided.

booking.note: recreation.gov rules: maxStay 14 days, minWeekendStay/minHolidayWeekendStay 0 ('soft'), reservationCutOff 1 day prior to arrival. The Forest Service page's 'two night minimum stay on weekends and a three night minimum stay on holidays' and '240 days in advance' are older text (the page still carries a 2009-2011 PG&E dam notice); recreation.gov is current. recreation.gov's calendar shows the campground Closed 2026-10-16 to 2027-05-20. Sites 110-113 (20 ft) are not reservable.
